chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.UNCLE1: UNCLE1: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a grey moustache, wearing a brown wool djellaba with the hood down
chars.UNCLE2: UNCLE2: a thin bald Moroccan man in his forties with a short black beard, wearing a navy tracksuit with white side stripes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, inside the courtyard of an old ochre stone rural house near Agadir. UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 stand close together whispering guiltily, UNCLE2 hiding a dusty old metal box behind his back, both caught mid-act and looking up startled toward the viewer. Seen from the courtyard doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centered, calm walls at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, inside the courtyard of an old ochre stone rural house near Agadir. NARRATOR stands facing UNCLE1 and UNCLE2, arms crossed, serious determined face; the two uncles look uneasy at each other. Medium shot, faces visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, inside the courtyard of an old ochre stone rural house near Agadir. NARRATOR points a finger forward with a knowing confident half smile, eyebrows raised, as if saying 'I know everything'. Head-to-waist shot, face clearly visible, centered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, inside the courtyard of an old ochre stone rural house near Agadir. UNCLE1 throws his hands up in fake surprise and UNCLE2 shakes his head denying, both with exaggerated innocent faces, slightly comic. Medium shot, faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, inside a dim old stone room of the grandfather's house. NARRATOR lifts a sheet of cardboard revealing a fresh deep hole in the dirt floor, other holes covered with cardboard nearby; UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 stand behind him looking embarrassed and caught. Medium-wide shot, faces visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, a simple Moroccan living room with low sofas and a round wooden table with a teapot. UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 sit across from NARRATOR, UNCLE1 explaining with open hands, guilty and nervous; NARRATOR listens skeptically. Medium shot, faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, same Moroccan living room. NARRATOR stands up holding his phone up as if about to call, angry stern face; UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 on the sofa lean back with wide scared eyes. Medium shot, faces visible, centered.
